newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - CommNet Cellular raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CommNet Cellular raised.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said it upgraded CommNet Cellular Inc to buy from hold and set a target price of $37 a share.
-- said company's fundamental results have been strong and higher than expectations.
-- said CommNet is fairly insulated from competition. Five years from now, Salomon expects CommNet will see competition in only 10 percent of its markets.
-- said CommNet's rural markets will not attract much competition from personal communications service (PCS) carriers.

-- said dual band phones are expected to become available later this year. CommNet stands to gain incremental high-margin roaming/resale revenue from PCS carriers whose customers use dual band phones in CommNet's territory.
-- said this dual band benefit could give CommNet an eventual 10 percent revenue boost and a 15 percent cash flow boost.
-- said expects CommNet's cash flow will grow over 40 percent this year and compound at nearly 20 percent through the year 2000.
